issues.title: Focused contact cannot authorize an otherwise in-range attack
issues.intendedBehavior: Give the controller a coherent distinction between current contact, remembered contact and fictional attack eligibility.
issues.actualBehavior: Observe produces current observed contact, but attack uses the separate passive-only predicate. At 3 tiles +100 units a crouched rival yields an observed location inside nominal attack range with no Attack entry. At resolution a change in passive visibility alone can turn an otherwise identical rolled hit into a miss.
issues.reproduction: Run the focus and posture probes with clear center ray; compare seed 1 base and crouch inputs at the same due.
issues.gameplayImpact: Observe is one-update information only and cannot bridge this specific eligibility gap; eligibility is effectively narrower by posture.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Specify acquisition versus resolution semantics, then test both against the same geometry.

issues.title: Continuous events can arrive between decisions without reaching the next controller sample
issues.intendedBehavior: Keep strategic decisions bounded while allowing meaningful changes to influence later plans.
issues.actualBehavior: Only one current/last contact with position and time; no event summary. Fixed 4s Objective and ~8.334s default Score grid exceed the 2.2s memory age; own defeat clears plan but respawn does not request a new one. Core state is exposed at the next checkpoint only.
issues.reproduction: Compare focus detection at 0.467s and TTL to recorded offline checkpoint schedule; inspect ordinary-score respawn and ordinary-objective activation.
issues.gameplayImpact: Fresh Core/live context may be actionable in the engine while previously queued intent or null persists for seconds.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Review a small filtered event digest or bounded wakeup policy; preserve provider request caps and no substitution.

issues.title: Provider movement catalog is narrower than the authoritative input geometry
issues.intendedBehavior: Make continuous movement and interruption useful to every controller through bounded input.
issues.actualBehavior: Provider gets only cell-center walk/run/crouch destinations and eligible directional jumps. Manual input has directional steer; engine also accepts safe off-center destinations. Movement and jump choices filtered now can never become selected later in the same window; ordinary actions can.
issues.reproduction: Compare the start prompt choices to the off-center walk probe and input union.
issues.gameplayImpact: Continuous state does not imply a continuous model action vocabulary. Legal change-of-direction alternatives may be omitted.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Use a compact decision vocabulary that exposes useful steering/stop options or carefully bounded destinations.

issues.title: Posture and locomotion can disagree
issues.intendedBehavior: Maintain a legible distinction between crouched posture and movement risk-reward.
issues.actualBehavior: Walk preserves crouched posture but applies full walk speed and walk accuracy penalty; rival still sees the crouched passive range. Crouch-mode entry changes pose and speed together, and the usual manual path selects crouch mode when crouched.
issues.reproduction: Start Blue crouched and issue a walk steer; compare returned posture, motion and displacement.
issues.gameplayImpact: Input sources can combine the same visible posture with differing movement costs.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Decide whether crouched walking is a supported arcade state; make the UI, action validator and outcomes communicate the same rule.

issues.title: Action due timestamps and actual resolution differ by one boundary
issues.intendedBehavior: Time-based effects resolve predictably and timing is described in the active simulation units.
issues.actualBehavior: Legacy durations convert from 110ms units, then ceil to the active 30Hz boundary. Attack 770→800ms, reload 1320→1333⅓ms, observe 440→466⅔ms, peek 880→900ms. RNG uses due rather than resolution time. A short final step can change the rounding.
issues.reproduction: Read actual due/first-frame rules, confirm Observe completion at 1400 units and replay timestamps.
issues.gameplayImpact: Serialized due, effective responsiveness, and presentation can be mistaken for one value.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Document both clocks and test due immediately before/at/after deadlines; keep historical rounding stable.

issues.title: Attack resolves before movement within the boundary
issues.intendedBehavior: Make same-boundary ordering understandable in a continuous simulation.
issues.actualBehavior: New posture applies before firing resolution, but positions remain the previous boundary's until after shots and survey completion. Damage and visible event land in a frame holding the new positions. Blocked movement clears motion after the shot calculation.
issues.reproduction: Compare stepWorld ordering, equal-seed posture probe, near-boundary movement fixture and renderer update.
issues.gameplayImpact: A spectator can see a different position from the one used by a resolving shot. The preferred ordering is a design decision.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Document/order explicitly and add boundary regression tests before considering a rule change.

issues.title: Respawn restores visibility without a matching contact-enter event
issues.intendedBehavior: Keep observable contact transitions consistent with top-level life lifecycle.
issues.actualBehavior: Visibility transition runs before respawn. At the respawn state, observation immediately sees a live rival; next world step recomputes previous visibility as already true even without a stored contact, so it does not generate the missing enter.
issues.reproduction: Load ordinary-score tick 311; compare respawn event, Sand observed contact at 20160 and next events.
issues.gameplayImpact: Any consumer relying on contact event edges, rather than polling, can miss new contact.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Define life/visibility ordering or reconcile contact edges after respawn.

issues.title: Manual input can stop reasserting a held steer after collision
issues.intendedBehavior: Held manual direction should have defined behavior when a temporary obstacle moves away.
issues.actualBehavior: World clears motion on collision. Input adapter caches the last dispatched dx/dy/mode and sends another steer only if this signature changes, except jump or respawn resets. A held direction need not restart when an agent obstruction clears.
issues.reproduction: Trace a held attempted direction after an agent collision, then compare signature before and after opponent movement.
issues.confidence: High from source, end-to-end repro pending
issues.gameplayImpact: Manual feel can understate world responsiveness while steer is held.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Create a browser fixture spanning dynamic separation and distinguish explicit hold/retry from collision stop.

issues.title: Development policy benchmark constrains behaviors
issues.intendedBehavior: Use deterministic policies to establish coverage while keeping their behavior distinct from engine potential and genuine model behavior.
issues.actualBehavior: Profiles sample every 440ms phase, snap ordinary waypoints to cells, limit or defer replan; Score controllers won't revise while moving after no usable attack; Core controller returns null during a channel despite compatible commands; default pending Defender does not specifically pressure the Core.
issues.reproduction: Compare ordinary-objective #117 and ordinary-score #311 and policy code, plus existing V2.5 early-pressure comparison.
issues.gameplayImpact: Balance distributions and apparent idle periods reflect controller policy as well as mode rules.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Separate controller cohorts and define comparable capabilities before rerunning balance.

issues.title: Spectator effects can miss authoritative events under frame batching
issues.intendedBehavior: Render meaningful replay events and distinguish spectator information from agent knowledge.
issues.actualBehavior: Playback calls show for each elapsed frame but publishes only latest frame to Phaser. Earlier attack flash/respawn effects can be omitted if several ticks are consumed; signal text can also be overwritten before browser paints. Under default view both agents are always rendered.
issues.reproduction: Throttle or block browser across a multi-frame replay interval and inspect last-frame-only code path; current browser proof verifies steady playback result only.
issues.confidence: High from source, runtime effect loss pending
issues.gameplayImpact: Missed intermediate cues make hit, awareness or respawn behavior look inconsistent without changing match results.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Consume ordered events independently of render frame and add a filtered observation overlay for audit.

issues.title: V2.5 live round trip, memory, and on-chain verification remain gated or incomplete
issues.intendedBehavior: Keep rule-matched identity, memory and results verifiable with actual evidence.
issues.actualBehavior: V2.5 runner accepts compatible lessons in isolation; API passes coaching only, sets memory revisions zero and skips reflection. Production viewer/V1 verifier do not execute V2.5. Protected provider result is unverified in this sprint.
issues.reproduction: Inspect API branch and previously recorded integration evidence; injected local tests only.
issues.gameplayImpact: V2.5 cannot establish real model responsiveness or competitive deployment readiness yet.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Verify local corrections first, then run protected genuine comparisons only when authorized. Keep V1 attestation and replay separate.

issues.title: Exact-reference imports retain historical duplicate-defeat behavior
issues.intendedBehavior: Preserve earlier outcomes and stored events without contaminating current presets.
issues.actualBehavior: Reference uses historical non-live-only branch. Already-defeated case can emit repeated defeat and remain obstructive/targetable until terminal. Default and reference-live use live checks.
issues.reproduction: Compare exact reference and reference-live from V2.5 benchmark and current V2.5 tests.
issues.gameplayImpact: Historical control invalid for interpreting current defeat/event rates without annotation.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Maintain frozen fixture expectations and label historical control.

issues.title: One command per side limits same-boundary independent state changes
issues.intendedBehavior: Allow compatible game states to overlap and respond at the next practical boundary.
issues.actualBehavior: Movement can continue during a compatible action, but two new inputs cannot start for one side on the same step; key queue selects one action before changed steering. Firing or peek disables further actions selectively.
issues.reproduction: Compare WALK+existing reload matrix row and stop then precision requiring two decision slots.
issues.gameplayImpact: Compatible persistence is present, while command bundling and same-boundary starting are limited.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Retain single input unless owner requires simultaneous starts; define precedence and measure effective latency first.

issues.title: Filtered prompt omits available game feedback and active timer detail
issues.intendedBehavior: Let an agent assess its own prior action outcomes, limits and progress from authorized information.
issues.actualBehavior: Own active firing/reload/survey have labels/booleans but no due time, destination or friendly event outcomes. Full replay has them. Rival positions only through legitimate contact; Core public interaction includes opponent role/side and progress, which implies the actor is within the Core diamond.
issues.reproduction: Compare prompt keys and filtered views to replay state and events; test distinct same-position obscured and visible states.
issues.gameplayImpact: A model may see that it spent ammo without knowing hit/miss or when currently running actions complete. Exact rival hidden position/HP not serialized in audited prompts.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Add filtered feedback and documentation of what Core information is public; preserve privacy tests.

issues.title: Posture, behavior and world-radius boundary coverage is incomplete
issues.intendedBehavior: Exercise interactions and exact boundaries with reachable transcripts in addition to synthetic snapshots.
issues.actualBehavior: Current tests cover continuous motion, sweeps, basic privacy, concurrency, simultaneous damage, clock and parity samples. They do not assert contact pulse end-to-end, filtered-event lifetime under real windows, held steer recovery, batched effects, full mixed-mode matrix, or low-end browser timing.
issues.reproduction: Compare the named existing tests to diagnostics and explicit coverage gap list.
issues.gameplayImpact: Passing deterministic regression suite cannot determine competitive feel or provider agency.
issues.suggestedCorrectionDirection: Promote reproduced interactions to targeted regressions with both reachable and precise fixtures.
